channel.title: Expel incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Expel's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Emails from Workbench delayed since 12am UTC [resolved]
item.description:
This issue is resolved. Email delivery from Workbench has been restored, and phishing email submissions are processing normally.
Suspected phishing emails submitted during this time were not received by Expel and could not be processed. Please ask your users to resubmit anything they reported during this period.
Notification emails generated during this time have been delivered. Some may arrive later than the timestamp they were originally generated.

item.title: Workbench Availability due to Database Issue [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been resolved, and all systems are once again fully available. No customer data was lost; SOC operations were impacted, but are back to normal.

item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Alert ingestion delayed for a subset of security devices [resolved]
item.description: We restored the credentials for the subset of devices, and are seeing that the majority of devices have returned to a healthy state. We investigated the remaining unhealthy devices, which are not related to the customer secrets vault upgrade. This incident is resolved.

item.title: Workbench Unable To Deliver Microsoft Teams Notifications [resolved]
item.description: Resolved: Microsoft has confirmed that the issues affecting Teams bots and message delivery are now fully resolved. All delayed messages have been reprocessed and delivered. Service is operating normally.

item.title: Alert Ingestion Outage for AWS GuardDuty [resolved]
item.description:
Workaround is in place, we are bypassing the faulty AWS region and all impacted devices have resumed ingestion.
Once the outage in the faulty region is over, we will resume ingestion in that region.
Alert Ingestion issue resolved.
